outcome: Resolve routine enquiries and complaints faster with cited policy, authorised actions, multilingual support, and accountable escalation.
overview: Retail service teams answer the same questions in two languages while hunting through order systems, product data and policy documents that rarely agree. This solution grounds every answer in current, cited policy and live order data, authenticates the customer before anything sensitive is disclosed, and executes only low-risk actions inside an approved tool allowlist and transaction limit. Disputed, regulated or sensitive cases escalate to a named human with full context rather than being improvised. An 8-week intent pilot measures handling time, first-contact resolution and remedy correctness in Arabic and English against a service baseline, with a policy-citation audit on every sampled response.

benefits.text: Reduce average handling time on the piloted intents by a target 25%
benefits.source: Redington Retail catalogue; consistent with published contact-centre AI-assist benchmark ranges
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Target to validate on the customer’s own contact mix during the 8-week pilot — not a guarantee, and it does not apply to intents outside the pilot scope

benefits.text: Improve first-contact resolution and reduce repeat contacts on the same order or complaint
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on knowledge freshness and on the remedy authority the customer grants at each tier

benefits.text: Answer in Arabic and English from cited, current policy rather than agent recollection
benefits.source: Reference design — retrieval bound to approved policy sources with mandatory citation
benefits.limits: Answer quality is bounded by the accuracy and currency of the policy library it cites; bilingual review is required

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); customer, order and conversation data remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs

notFor.situation: No maintained policy library with named content owners and review dates
notFor.why: Every answer is cited to a source; where the source is stale, the citation makes the wrong answer look authoritative

notFor.situation: No CRM or order APIs the assistant can read and act against
notFor.why: Without live order context the assistant can only paraphrase policy, which is the part agents already do well

notFor.situation: The expectation is fully autonomous service with no human escalation path
notFor.why: The design escalates disputed, regulated and sensitive cases by policy; there is no unattended mode for them

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns service policy, knowledge content, remedy authority and every escalated decision · Duration: 6–10 weeks pilot; further 12–22 weeks to enterprise scale
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, conversational AI engineer, integration engineer; customer service owner, knowledge owner, legal reviewer, IT security lead, bilingual quality reviewer · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Discovery, intent analysis and service baseline
2) Policy library preparation and bilingual review
3) Retrieval, guardrail and tool-gateway configuration
4) Gold-intent evaluation, security and red-team testing
5) Controlled intent pilot with weekly quality review
6) Benefit review, citation audit and handover
